scope: Bounded backend/scheduling comparison on Motorola Edge40Pro and the two locked GGUFs. M4 corrections/M5 final profiles remain open; no product or general-device acceptance.

decisions.cpu: 1/2/3/4/5/6/7 threads and big-core affinity screened. Tiny affinity gain did not warrant promotion;7-worker sustained tail gain below3% and start caps differed. Retain4-auto.
decisions.vulkan: OEM shader compiler crashes on tested matvec pipeline; CPU recovery passed. No GPU profile shipped.
decisions.opencl: 45 required dtype micro cases pass; BF16 storage conversion forbidden. Both tested real Ornith8-layer profiles fail unchanged NLL/logit gates; no larger offload tried after failure.
decisions.hexagon_alternatives: Locked source/license/import feasibility filter retained; no demonstrated free exact-weight path for these artifacts. No alternate weights/conversion downloaded.
